## Books Location

A reporting dimension for where a transaction happened: a site, store, roastery or warehouse. Its only stored field is `name`; `cardTitle` is the name.

Documents carry the location as a plain string (`loc`) on their posting lines, matched to this card's `name`. Roast batches and fulfillments put `loc` on every line they post; purchase orders carry it as well. The card itself computes nothing and has no operations.

```ts
import { BooksLocation } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-dimensions';
```

### Non-goals
No address, no stock-by-location tracking, and no location report in this module (Profit by Class groups by class only).

### Example
No example ships for this card.
